metadata.title: Transfer Pricing Compliance Platform Data Assets
metadata.description: Catalog of the transfer pricing model, documentation, country content, CbCR and benchmark, compliance workflow, legal entity and agreement, and platform, AI and service data assets that power the annual transfer pricing lifecycle (Model, Scope, Collect, Generate, Localise, File, Monitor, Defend) on the Reptune.net platform, with classification, GDPR, tax secrecy, OECD CbCR confidentiality, EU Public CbCR disclosure and tax documentation retention governance, ISO 27001 controls, backing stores and team ownership.

rootGroups.name: Transfer Pricing Model Data
rootGroups.description: The intelligent transfer pricing data model that Reptune has developed since 2015: company types and functional analyses configured once, the register of intercompany transactions per entity, segmented financials per activity, and the batches and validation findings through which entity data enters the model. This is the strategic asset: every Local File, Master File and CbCR is generated from it without manual changes to the exported files, so its integrity decides documentation quality everywhere.

subGroups.name: Transfer Pricing Model
subGroups.description: The rule-based model: company types, functional analyses, transfer pricing methods and benchmark references applied across all entities, the intercompany transactions in scope and the segmented financial results that prove arm's-length outcomes.

assets.name: Transfer Pricing Model
assets.description: The configured transfer pricing model of one client organisation: the group's transfer pricing policy per transaction type, the transfer pricing methods selected (CUP, resale price, cost plus, TNMM, profit split), tested parties and profit level indicators, benchmark references per transaction type and validity period, the mapping of legal entities to company types and functional analyses, the OECD-aligned template structure selected for Master File and Local Files, group-level narrative (business overview, value chain, intangibles, financing) and model versions per fiscal year. Set up in Transfer Pricing Model, Company Types and Functional Analyses (tpmd) during onboarding with the R-AI onboarding assistant and Excel bulk entry, and read by the Master File and Local File Generator (gene) at every generation run.
assets.businessMeaning: The group's transfer pricing policy made executable: configured once, it makes documentation consistent across 5 to 500+ entities and turns an annual documentation project into a generation run.
assets.accessScope: group tax and transfer pricing staff of the owning client organisation with model-admin rights; Reptune specialists under a service engagement; advisers for the client organisations they are linked to; local contacts see only the entity mappings that concern them

interfaces.name: transfer-pricing-model api
interfaces.description: Model configuration, versioning, entity-to-company-type mapping, method and benchmark assignment and fiscal-year snapshot API used by the model set-up module, the report generator, pre-generation validation, scoping, R-AI onboarding and the Excel bulk-entry importer.

interfaces.name: model change events
interfaces.description: Model created, policy changed, method assigned, benchmark linked, fiscal-year version frozen and entity mapping changed events consumed by validation, the generator's staleness checks, dashboards and the audit trail.

governance.retention: every fiscal-year model version kept for as long as the documentation it produced must be retained, in practice 7 to 10 years after the fiscal year depending on the longest local statute of limitations among the group's countries; frozen versions immutable
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation; visible to Reptune specialists only under an active service engagement or support ticket; shared with the client's advisers through explicit organisation links; never shared between client organisations; never used to train AI models

assets.name: Company Type Profile
assets.description: A reusable functional profile applied to one or more legal entities: company type (for example limited-risk distributor, contract manufacturer, principal, shared service centre, IP owner, holding), the functional analysis in terms of functions performed, assets used and risks assumed, characterisation for transfer pricing purposes, the standard intercompany transaction types such an entity engages in, the applicable transfer pricing method and tested-party logic, and the standard narrative paragraphs the generator uses when writing the functional analysis section of a Local File. Maintained in Transfer Pricing Model, Company Types and Functional Analyses (tpmd); every entity inherits its profile so that a change in the functional analysis propagates to all Local Files of that type.
assets.businessMeaning: The reuse mechanism that makes 170-country documentation affordable: one functional analysis written well is applied to every entity of the same type instead of being rewritten per country.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff with model-admin rights; Reptune specialists under a service engagement; read-only for local contacts and advisers linked to the organisation

interfaces.name: company-type-profile api
interfaces.description: Profile catalogue, functional analysis text, transaction-type and method defaults, and entity assignment API used by model set-up, the report generator, AI-assisted writing and the R-AI onboarding assistant.

interfaces.name: profile change events
interfaces.description: Profile created, functional analysis text changed and profile reassigned events consumed by the generator's change detection, validation and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept with the model version it belongs to, 7 to 10 years after the last fiscal year in which it was applied; superseded profile text versioned, never deleted while a generated file references it
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation and its linked advisers and Reptune specialists; Reptune's best-practice standard profiles are Reptune content shared read-only with all clients; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Intercompany Transaction
assets.description: A controlled transaction between two group entities in scope for a fiscal year: transaction type (goods, services, royalties, financing, cost contribution, guarantees), provider and recipient entity, the underlying intercompany agreement, transfer pricing method and tested party, pricing basis (mark-up, royalty rate, interest rate), currency and amount per fiscal year, materiality against local documentation thresholds, benchmark reference and arm's-length range, and the value chain step it belongs to. Registered in the Intercompany Transactions Register (ictx) manually or through bulk upload, segmented by Segmented Financials and P&L Segmentation (segp), covered by the Intercompany Agreement Repository (icag) and assessed in Risk Management and Value Chain Analysis (rskm).
assets.businessMeaning: The unit of transfer pricing risk: every Local File section, benchmark comparison, threshold test and tax-audit question resolves to a transaction between two entities.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff of the owning client organisation; local contacts see transactions of their own entities; advisers and Reptune specialists per organisation link or engagement; never visible across client organisations

interfaces.name: intercompany-transaction api
interfaces.description: Register, bulk-import, threshold-test, agreement-link and per-entity query API used by the transactions register, segmentation, the generator, benchmarking, risk management, the legal module and ERP integrations.

interfaces.name: transaction bulk templates
interfaces.description: Excel template import and export of transaction lists per entity and fiscal year, including the custom transactional data model of Enterprise clients and pushes from operational transfer pricing solutions.

interfaces.name: transaction events
interfaces.description: Transaction added, amount updated, agreement linked or missing, threshold crossed and benchmark out-of-range events consumed by validation, actions required, risk management, dashboards and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept per fiscal year for 7 to 10 years after the fiscal year according to the longest documentation retention obligation among the countries involved; amounts of frozen fiscal years immutable, corrections recorded as new versions
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation; disclosed to tax authorities only through the generated Local Files and CbCR the client files itself; shared with advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Segmented Financial Statement
assets.description: The financial results of a legal entity for a fiscal year split per activity or transaction type so that the tested party's profit level indicator can be compared with its arm's-length range: statutory P&L and balance sheet lines, allocation keys and segmentation rules per activity (for example distribution versus contract manufacturing), segmented revenue, cost of sales, operating expenses and operating profit, computed indicators (operating margin, net cost plus, return on assets), currency and source (ERP extract, Excel template, operational transfer pricing solution), reviewer and approval status. Maintained in Segmented Financials and P&L Segmentation (segp) and compared with benchmark ranges in Benchmark Studies, Arm's-Length Ranges and Entity Comparison (bnch).
assets.businessMeaning: The proof of the pudding: whether each entity actually earned an arm's-length result last year, which is what a tax auditor tests first and what the dashboard's financial performance widgets show.
assets.accessScope: group tax and finance staff of the owning client organisation; local finance controllers for their own entities; Reptune specialists and advisers per engagement; figures shown in dashboards only to users with financial-data rights

interfaces.name: segmented-financials api
interfaces.description: Entity financials, segmentation rule, allocation and indicator calculation API with range-comparison queries, used by the segmentation module, benchmark comparison, the generator's financial tables, validation and dashboards.

interfaces.name: financial data templates
interfaces.description: Excel templates for entity financials and segmentation, direct ERP integration extracts and operational transfer pricing pushes with validation before acceptance.

interfaces.name: financials events
interfaces.description: Financials uploaded, segmentation completed, indicator out of range and financials approved events consumed by actions required, benchmark comparison, dashboards and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept 7 to 10 years after the fiscal year in line with tax documentation retention in the entity's country; approved fiscal-year figures immutable, restatements stored as new versions
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation; disclosed to tax authorities through the Local File financial annexes the client files; shared with auditors and advisers on request; never shared between client organisations; only anonymised indicator distributions may feed cross-client benchmarks

subGroups.name: Data Intake and Validation
subGroups.description: How entity data enters the model and is checked before generation: Excel templates, bulk uploads, ERP extracts and the validation findings that become actions required.

assets.name: Data Upload Batch
assets.description: One delivery of data into the platform: an Excel template upload (entities, transactions, financials, CbCR tables, translations), an ERP extract pulled by a direct integration, or a push from an operational transfer pricing solution: source system and connection, uploading user or service account, client organisation and fiscal year, file checksum and row counts, mapping version applied, parse and validation results per row, accepted and rejected rows, and final state (staged, accepted into the model, partially accepted, rejected). Created by Excel Templates, Bulk Upload and Data Validation (xlio) and by ERP and Operational Transfer Pricing Integrations (erpi).
assets.businessMeaning: The audit trail of where every number came from: a tax auditor asking why a Local File shows a figure is answered by the batch that delivered it.
assets.accessScope: the uploading user and data admins of the owning client organisation; integration operators of Reptune for connection troubleshooting under support access; raw files never visible to other organisations

interfaces.name: data-upload api
interfaces.description: Template download, upload, mapping, dry-run validation, accept and roll-back API used by the bulk-upload module, ERP integrations, operational transfer pricing connectors and the actions-required page.

interfaces.name: excel templates and erp extracts
interfaces.description: Versioned Excel templates for every model object and CbCR table, SFTP and API extracts from ERP systems and operational transfer pricing solutions, and rejected-row reports returned to the uploader.

interfaces.name: upload lifecycle events
interfaces.description: Batch received, validated, accepted, partially accepted, rejected and rolled back events consumed by validation findings, workflow tasks, integration health monitoring and the audit trail.

governance.retention: raw staged files purged 90 days after acceptance or rejection; batch metadata, row counts, checksums and mapping versions kept 7 to 10 years with the fiscal-year data they delivered so that data lineage can be shown in an audit
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation; batch metadata visible to Reptune integration operators for support; raw files never shared; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Validation Finding
assets.description: One issue detected by the platform's built-in validation on the way from data to documentation: missing entity financials, transaction without agreement, transaction above a local threshold without documentation scope, missing functional analysis, benchmark expired or out of range, inconsistent amounts between counterparties, missing translation or local form, or a CbCR table failing the OECD schema: rule id and severity (blocking, warning, information), the object it concerns (entity, transaction, section, CbCR table), fiscal year, suggested action, assignee, state (open, resolved, waived with reason) and resolution timestamp. Raised by Excel Templates, Bulk Upload and Data Validation (xlio) at intake and by Pre-generation Validation and Actions Required (vald) before generation.
assets.businessMeaning: What stands between the data and a defensible file: the Actions Required page is the daily to-do list of a documentation coordinator and the reason files are not generated with gaps.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff and local contacts of the owning client organisation according to the object a finding concerns; Reptune specialists per engagement; advisers per organisation link

interfaces.name: validation-finding api
interfaces.description: Rule catalogue, finding query, assignment, resolution and waiver API used by the actions-required page, the generator's pre-flight, bulk upload, CbCR validation, workflow tasks and dashboards.

interfaces.name: validation events
interfaces.description: Finding raised, resolved, waived and blocking-finding-cleared events consumed by workflow tasks, generation gating, the compliance dashboard and the audit trail.

governance.retention: findings kept with the fiscal year they belong to for 7 to 10 years so that waivers and resolutions can be explained in an audit; rule catalogue versions kept indefinitely
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation and its linked advisers and Reptune specialists; aggregated finding statistics without client data used by Reptune to improve templates and rules; never shared between client organisations

rootGroups.name: Documentation Data
rootGroups.description: The generated deliverables of three-tiered documentation and the templates they are built from: Master Files, Local Files in draft and final form in every language, and the OECD-aligned, localised and custom templates, styling and custom text that determine how the generator writes them. These documents contain commercially sensitive financials, pricing policies and the names of directors and signatories, and are what tax authorities eventually read.

subGroups.name: Generated Documentation
subGroups.description: The Master File and Local File documents generated per fiscal year, entity and country, with their versions, languages, review and filing state.

assets.name: Master File Document
assets.description: The group-level Master File for a fiscal year as required by OECD BEPS Action 13 and the local rules that adopt it: organisational structure, description of the business and value drivers, supply chain of main products and services, intangibles and their ownership, intercompany financial activities, financial and tax positions including the CbCR reference and existing APAs and rulings, generated from the transfer pricing model with the group narrative, structure charts and financial overview inserted; version, draft or final state, language versions, reviewers and sign-off, generation run reference and the Word and PDF output files. Generated by the Master File and Local File Generator (gene) and rendered and exported by Document Rendering and Export (docx).
assets.businessMeaning: The group's single story told once and reused by every Local File: consistency between the Master File and the Local Files is the first thing a coordinated multi-country audit tests.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff of the owning client organisation; local contacts and advisers with Master File rights; Reptune specialists per engagement; downloads and exports logged; location-restricted profiles cannot open it

interfaces.name: master-file api
interfaces.description: Generate, regenerate, version, review, finalise and secure-download API for the Master File used by the generator, document rendering, workflow tasks, the compliance dashboard and the archive.

interfaces.name: master file outputs
interfaces.description: Word and PDF outputs in corporate styling per language version, delivered through the web application and expiring download links; imported prior-year files accepted for the archive.

interfaces.name: master file events
interfaces.description: Generated, reviewed, finalised, translated, downloaded and superseded events consumed by workflow, deadline tracking, dashboards, the audit trail and reminders.

governance.retention: every generated version kept at least 7 years and up to 10 years after the fiscal year, matching the longest statute of limitations among the group's countries; final versions immutable; the archive retained after contract end for the export period agreed with the client
governance.sharingPolicy: owned by the client organisation and filed or provided to tax authorities by the client itself; shared with the client's advisers and auditors through organisation links; visible to Reptune specialists per engagement; never shared between client organisations; never used to train AI models

assets.name: Local File Document
assets.description: The entity- and country-specific Local File for a fiscal year: local entity description, management structure and organisation chart, business strategy and restructurings, the controlled transactions with counterparties, amounts, agreements, functional analysis, method selection and comparability analysis, benchmark and arm's-length range, financial information and segmentation reconciled to statutory accounts, plus the country-specific sections, annexes and local forms the local rules require; generated in English from the model, localised with country templates and content rules, machine-translated with glossaries or human-certified, styled in the client's corporate identity with custom text, in draft or final state with reviewer sign-off, language versions, filing state and the Word and PDF output files. Generated by the Master File and Local File Generator (gene), shaped by Templates, Report Styling and Custom Text (tmpl), translated by Machine Translation and Glossaries (trns), edited with AI-assisted Writing and Editing (aiwr), versioned by Audit Trail, Versioning and Archive (audt) and rendered by Document Rendering and Export (docx).
assets.businessMeaning: The product the customer pays per unit for: plans are priced per Local File, specialists deliver at fixed rates per Local File, and a Local File that holds in a tax audit is the outcome every persona measures.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff of the owning client organisation; the local finance contact of the entity; advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; location-restricted user profiles see only their own countries; downloads, exports and translations logged

interfaces.name: local-file api
interfaces.description: Generate, regenerate, localise, translate, version, review, finalise and secure-download API for Local Files used by the generator, templates, translation, AI writing, workflow, dashboards, full-service workspace and the archive.

interfaces.name: local file outputs
interfaces.description: Word and PDF outputs per entity, country and language in corporate styling, local forms and annexes, and ZIP export of a fiscal year's complete documentation set for filing or archiving.

interfaces.name: local file events
interfaces.description: Generated, section edited, translated, reviewed, finalised, filed and superseded events consumed by workflow tasks, deadline tracking, compliance dashboards, reminders and the audit trail.

governance.retention: every generated version kept 7 to 10 years after the fiscal year according to the entity's local documentation retention obligation (for example 7 years in the Netherlands, 10 years in several other jurisdictions); final versions immutable; archive exportable to the client after contract end
governance.sharingPolicy: owned by the client organisation and filed with or provided to the local tax authority by the client or its local adviser; shared with the entity's local contact, advisers and auditors; visible to Reptune specialists per engagement; certified translators receive only the file they translate under a processor agreement; never shared between client organisations; never used to train AI models

subGroups.name: Templates and Styling
subGroups.description: The OECD-aligned template structure, localised and custom templates, report styling and custom text blocks that determine how the generator writes documentation.

assets.name: Report Template
assets.description: A template that structures generated documentation: Reptune's best-practice standard Master File and Local File templates aligned with the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines and BEPS Action 13 Annexes I and II, localised country templates (for example the Italian Local File structure), custom templates for Advanced and Enterprise clients, section and paragraph definitions with generation rules and placeholders, report styling (fonts, colours, logos, cover pages, headers in the client's corporate identity), custom text blocks per entity, country or section, and effective-dated versions with change notes. Maintained in Templates, Report Styling and Custom Text (tmpl); Reptune's standard and country templates are maintained with the regulations specialists.
assets.businessMeaning: Where Reptune's transfer pricing expertise is encoded for every client: a template change updates all future files, and localised templates are why one model can produce locally compliant files in 170+ countries.
assets.accessScope: Reptune template and regulations specialists for standard and country templates; template admins of the owning client organisation for custom templates, styling and custom text; read-only for other users

interfaces.name: report-template api
interfaces.description: Template catalogue, section and placeholder definition, styling asset, custom text and versioning API used by the generator, the styling editor, localisation, AI-assisted writing and document rendering.

interfaces.name: template change events
interfaces.description: Template published, country template updated, styling changed and custom text edited events consumed by the generator's regeneration hints, validation and the audit trail.

governance.retention: every template version kept as long as a generated document references it, in practice 7 to 10 years; Reptune standard template history kept indefinitely as product content
governance.sharingPolicy: Reptune standard and country templates are Reptune intellectual property licensed read-only to all clients; custom templates, styling and custom text are owned by the client organisation and never shared with other clients

rootGroups.name: Country Content and Localisation Data
rootGroups.description: The knowledge base that makes documentation locally compliant in 170+ countries: regulation records per country maintained by Reptune's regulations specialists, the deadline rules and calculated deadlines derived from them, and the transfer pricing glossaries that steer machine translation into 28 languages. This is Reptune's second strategic asset and the content behind R-AI's country-expert mode.

subGroups.name: Country Regulations and Deadlines
subGroups.description: Effective-dated regulation content per country and the filing deadlines calculated from it per entity and fiscal year.

assets.name: Country Regulation Record
assets.description: The effective-dated transfer pricing documentation rule set of one country: legal basis and adoption of OECD BEPS Action 13, Master File, Local File and CbCR obligations and their thresholds (revenue, transaction value, group size), required content and structure beyond the OECD standard, language and certified-translation requirements, filing versus preparation-on-request regimes, deadline rules relative to fiscal-year end or tax return, local forms and procedures (for example transfer pricing disclosure forms), CbCR notification rules, penalty regime, statute of limitations and retention period, sources and change notes with the specialist who verified them. Maintained in Country Regulations, Local Requirements and Local Forms (ctry) by Reptune's regulations specialists, consumed by the Deadline Calculation Engine (dead) and retrieved by the R-AI Assistant (rai) for country-expert answers.
assets.businessMeaning: Reptune's regulatory knowledge as data: whether a Local File is required, what it must contain, in which language and by when, for every country a multinational operates in.
assets.accessScope: Reptune regulations specialists edit; all client users, advisers and R-AI read the current version; change history visible to Reptune content team

interfaces.name: country-regulation api
interfaces.description: Country rule lookup, threshold test, content and language requirement, local form and effective-date query API used by localisation, the deadline engine, scoping, validation, the generator's country sections, R-AI retrieval and the country regulations pages.

interfaces.name: regulation change events
interfaces.description: Rule set published, threshold changed, deadline rule changed and local form updated events consumed by deadline recalculation, scoping alerts, template maintenance, R-AI re-indexing and the change log.

governance.retention: every effective-dated version kept indefinitely so that documentation generated under an earlier rule set can be defended against the rules in force at the time
governance.sharingPolicy: Reptune content maintained by the regulations team and licensed to all clients as part of the platform; sources cited to official tax authority and OECD publications; not personal data; may be published in part as marketing content

assets.name: Filing Deadline
assets.description: A calculated compliance date for one obligation of one entity or group in one country for a fiscal year: Master File, Local File, CbCR filing, CbCR notification, local transfer pricing form or preparation-on-request date; derived from the country's deadline rule, the entity's fiscal-year end and tax return date, extensions granted, and any override with reason; with status (upcoming, due soon, met, missed, not applicable), the responsible user, reminder schedule and the document or notification that satisfied it. Calculated automatically by the Deadline Calculation Engine (dead) from Country Regulations, Local Requirements and Local Forms (ctry), tracked for notifications by CbCR Notifications (cbcn) and shown per entity on the Compliance Dashboard and Worldmap (dash).
assets.businessMeaning: Deadlines that are never missed is a core promise of the product: the calendar of obligations per entity is what the dashboard, the reminders and the on-time filing rate are built on.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff of the owning client organisation; local contacts for their own entities; advisers per organisation link; Reptune specialists per engagement

interfaces.name: filing-deadline api
interfaces.description: Deadline calculation, recalculation on rule or fiscal-year change, override, status and calendar API used by the deadline engine, workflow tasks, reminders, CbCR notifications, the dashboard worldmap and calendar exports.

interfaces.name: deadline events
interfaces.description: Deadline calculated, changed, due-soon, met and missed events consumed by e-mail reminders, workflow escalation, the compliance dashboard and the audit trail.

governance.retention: deadline history kept with the fiscal year for 7 to 10 years so that timely preparation can be evidenced in a penalty dispute; reminder logs 3 years
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation, its advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; calendar exports to the client's own calendar system; never shared between client organisations

subGroups.name: Translation Content
subGroups.description: Glossaries and translation memory that make machine translation of transfer pricing documentation consistent.

assets.name: Translation Glossary
assets.description: The terminology assets that steer AI-powered machine translation into 28 languages: Reptune's transfer pricing glossary per language pair (arm's-length principle, tested party, comparability, profit level indicator and the local tax authority's preferred terms), client-specific glossaries with product, entity and function names that must not be translated or must be translated consistently, do-not-translate lists, translation memory segments from previous years and from human-certified translations, and the reviewer corrections fed back into the engine. Maintained in Machine Translation and Glossaries (trns) with the regulations and content specialists for the Reptune glossaries and by client users for their own terms.
assets.businessMeaning: What keeps a translated Local File consistent with the English source and with last year's file: terminology drift is a common audit irritant and a rework driver for advisers.
assets.accessScope: Reptune content specialists for the standard glossaries; translation admins of the owning client organisation for client glossaries and memory; the translation engine reads both at run time

interfaces.name: translation-glossary api
interfaces.description: Glossary term, do-not-translate, translation memory lookup and correction feedback API used by the machine translation service, the document editor, certified-translation hand-off and AI-assisted writing.

interfaces.name: glossary exchange
interfaces.description: Excel and TBX import and export of glossaries and translation memory for certified translators and client language reviewers.

interfaces.name: glossary events
interfaces.description: Term added, correction accepted and memory updated events consumed by the translation engine cache and the audit trail.

governance.retention: Reptune glossaries kept indefinitely as product content; client glossaries and translation memory kept for the life of the client contract and exported or deleted at contract end; memory segments containing client text follow the documentation retention of the files they came from
governance.sharingPolicy: Reptune standard glossaries are Reptune content shared read-only with all clients; client glossaries and translation memory are client-owned, sent to the translation engine and to certified translators only under processor agreements, and never shared between client organisations

rootGroups.name: CbCR and Benchmark Data
rootGroups.description: The third tier of documentation and the economic evidence for the other two: Country-by-Country Reporting datasets exchanged between tax authorities under confidentiality, the EU Public CbCR report that is published, CbCR notifications, and the benchmark studies and arm's-length ranges that entity results are compared with.

subGroups.name: Country-by-Country Reporting
subGroups.description: CbCR datasets, their filing-ready XML and Excel outputs, the public XHTML and inline XBRL report, and the notifications each country requires.

assets.name: CbCR Dataset
assets.description: The Country-by-Country Report data of a multinational group for a reporting fiscal year under OECD BEPS Action 13: Table 1 per tax jurisdiction (revenues from related and unrelated parties, profit before tax, income tax paid and accrued, stated capital, accumulated earnings, number of employees, tangible assets), Table 2 constituent entities per jurisdiction with their main business activities, Table 3 additional information, reporting entity and ultimate parent, message and document reference ids, currency and source data provenance, validation status against the OECD CbC XML schema, versions and corrections, the generated XML and Excel outputs and filing acknowledgement. Maintained in CbCR Data Management and XML Output (cbcr) with manual or bulk entry and automated validation, and reused by EU Public CbCR (pcbc) and Pillar Two transitional safe-harbour analysis.
assets.businessMeaning: The group's global footprint in one table that every tax authority in the exchange network can read: it drives audit selection, so its consistency with the Master File and Local Files matters more than any single number.
assets.accessScope: group tax and CbCR staff of the owning client organisation with the CbCR add-on or Enterprise plan; Reptune specialists per engagement; not visible to local contacts unless granted; downloads of XML logged

interfaces.name: cbcr-dataset api
interfaces.description: Table entry, bulk import, schema validation, jurisdiction aggregation, XML and Excel generation, correction and version API used by the CbCR module, EU Public CbCR, the Master File's CbCR reference, notifications and dashboards.

interfaces.name: cbcr outputs
interfaces.description: OECD CbC XML schema files ready for upload to the tax authority portal, Excel workbooks for review, and bulk-entry templates from the group's consolidation system.

interfaces.name: cbcr events
interfaces.description: Dataset created, validation failed, validated, XML generated, filed and corrected events consumed by actions required, deadline tracking, notifications, the dashboard and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept at least 7 years and up to 10 years after the reporting fiscal year because the CbCR exchange and Pillar Two safe-harbour reliance can be examined in later audits; filed versions immutable
governance.sharingPolicy: filed by the client with the tax authority of the reporting entity and exchanged between tax authorities under the OECD confidentiality and appropriate-use conditions; visible to advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; never shared between client organisations; the public subset is disclosed only through the EU Public CbCR report

assets.name: Public CbCR Report
assets.description: The public country-by-country report required by EU Directive (EU) 2021/2101 for groups with consolidated revenue above EUR 750 million: the name of the ultimate parent, fiscal year, currency, a brief description of activities, number of employees, revenues, profit or loss before tax, income tax accrued and paid, and accumulated earnings per EU member state and per listed non-cooperative jurisdiction with other jurisdictions aggregated, generated from the existing CbCR dataset, tagged in XHTML with inline XBRL according to the Commission's electronic format, with omission and deferral disclosures, review and approval state, publication date and the location where it was published (company website, business register). Generated by EU Public CbCR (pcbc) and rendered by Document Rendering and Export (docx); Australian Public CbCR is a coming extension.
assets.businessMeaning: The one transfer pricing document that is meant to be read by the public and the press: it must reconcile to the confidential CbCR and be published in the prescribed machine-readable format within twelve months of the balance sheet date.
assets.accessScope: group tax, reporting and legal staff of the owning client organisation with the EU Public CbCR add-on; Reptune specialists per engagement; public once published by the client

interfaces.name: public-cbcr api
interfaces.description: Generate from CbCR dataset, jurisdiction aggregation, omission and deferral disclosure, inline XBRL tagging, validation, approval and export API used by the public CbCR module, document rendering and workflow.

interfaces.name: public cbcr outputs
interfaces.description: XHTML with inline XBRL for filing with the business register and publication on the company website, plus a PDF rendition for the annual report.

interfaces.name: public cbcr events
interfaces.description: Report generated, approved, published and superseded events consumed by deadline tracking, the dashboard and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept for the retention period applicable to the annual report it accompanies, at least 7 years and up to 10 years after the fiscal year; published versions immutable
governance.sharingPolicy: prepared by the client organisation and published by the client on its website and with the business register for at least five years as the Directive requires; before publication internal to the client, its advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement

assets.name: CbCR Notification
assets.description: The notification a constituent entity must file in its country to identify the reporting entity of the group for a fiscal year: notifying entity and country, reporting entity and its jurisdiction, fiscal year, notification type (ultimate parent, surrogate parent, local filing), the country-specific form or letter, language, due date derived from the country's rule, the responsible local contact, submission method and proof (portal receipt, letter, tax return checkbox), and status. Prepared and tracked in CbCR Notifications (cbcn) against Filing Deadlines calculated by the Deadline Calculation Engine.
assets.businessMeaning: The most frequently missed transfer pricing obligation because it is small and everywhere: automated notification calendars and forms per country are what keep penalties away.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff of the owning client organisation; the local contact of the notifying entity; advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement

interfaces.name: cbcr-notification api
interfaces.description: Notification generation per entity and country, form and letter rendering, submission recording and status API used by the notifications module, workflow tasks, deadlines and the dashboard.

interfaces.name: notification events
interfaces.description: Notification due, prepared, submitted and overdue events consumed by reminders, workflow escalation, the compliance dashboard and the audit trail.

governance.retention: notification records and proofs of submission kept 7 to 10 years with the fiscal year they concern
governance.sharingPolicy: submitted by the client's local entity to its tax authority; internal to the client organisation, its advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; never shared between client organisations

subGroups.name: Benchmarking
subGroups.description: Benchmark studies and arm's-length ranges archived in the platform and compared with each entity's segmented results.

assets.name: Benchmark Study
assets.description: An economic analysis supporting the arm's-length nature of a transaction type: transaction type and tested-party profile, database and search strategy (region, industry codes, independence and size screens), accept and reject matrix, the final comparable set with multi-year financials, the interquartile range and median of the profit level indicator, validity period and update or roll-forward schedule per the local rules that require refreshes every one to three years, the author (Reptune, the client or an adviser) and the study report; linked to the transactions it supports and compared per entity with the segmented financial statement. Maintained in Benchmark Studies, Arm's-Length Ranges and Entity Comparison (bnch) and inserted automatically into Local Files by the generator.
assets.businessMeaning: The evidence that prices are at arm's length: an expired or out-of-range benchmark is the most common documentation adjustment, and the range comparison per entity is the early warning.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff of the owning client organisation; advisers who authored or licensed the study; Reptune specialists per engagement; range comparison results visible to users with financial-data rights

interfaces.name: benchmark-study api
interfaces.description: Study registration, range and comparable-set entry, validity tracking, transaction linking and entity-versus-range comparison API used by the benchmarking module, the generator, validation, risk management and dashboards.

interfaces.name: benchmark reports
interfaces.description: Upload of study reports and comparable-set workbooks from Reptune's benchmark offerings, advisers or commercial databases, and export of range tables for Local File annexes.

interfaces.name: benchmark events
interfaces.description: Study added, expiring, expired, range updated and entity out-of-range events consumed by actions required, risk management, reminders and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept for as long as any Local File relying on the study must be retained, in practice 7 to 10 years after the last fiscal year it supported; superseded studies archived, never deleted while referenced
governance.sharingPolicy: study reports are the client's or the adviser's licensed work product and may be bound by the commercial database's licence terms; shared with tax authorities only as part of the filed Local File; visible to Reptune specialists per engagement; never shared between client organisations

rootGroups.name: Compliance Workflow Data
rootGroups.description: How the annual documentation cycle is run: which documentation is in scope per entity and country, who does what by when, the compliance status shown on the dashboard and worldmap, and the risk assessments and value chain analyses that turn documentation into audit readiness.

subGroups.name: Scoping and Tasks
subGroups.description: The scoped obligations per fiscal year and the tasks, assignments, collaboration and reminders that deliver them.

assets.name: Documentation Scope
assets.description: The set of documentation obligations a client organisation decides to prepare for a fiscal year: per legal entity and country, whether a Local File, Master File, CbCR, CbCR notification or local form is required, recommended or optional based on the country's thresholds and the entity's revenue and transaction volumes, the decision taken (in scope, out of scope with reason, deferred), the service level (On Demand, Collaborative, Full Service), language and translation choices, the assigned coordinator, local contact and adviser, and the resulting count of Local Files against the plan's allowance. Set in Documentation Scoping (scop), gated by Pre-generation Validation and Actions Required (vald), executed through Task Assignment, Collaboration and Reminders (task) and delivered under the Full Service Delivery Workspace (fsvc).
assets.businessMeaning: The plan of record for the annual cycle: it fixes what will be produced for whom, drives deadlines, tasks and dashboard coverage, and counts the Local Files the subscription is priced on.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff of the owning client organisation; local contacts and advisers for the entities assigned to them; Reptune specialists per engagement; scope counts visible to Reptune account management for plan sizing

interfaces.name: documentation-scope api
interfaces.description: Scope proposal from thresholds, decision, assignment, service-level and allowance-count API used by scoping, deadlines, tasks, validation, the generator, the full-service workspace and the dashboard.

interfaces.name: scope events
interfaces.description: Scope proposed, entity added or removed, decision changed, service level changed and scope frozen events consumed by deadline calculation, task creation, validation, dashboards and the audit trail.

governance.retention: scope decisions and their reasons kept 7 to 10 years with the fiscal year so that an out-of-scope decision can be justified in an audit
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation, its advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; scope counts used by Reptune for plan and fixed-rate invoicing; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Workflow Task
assets.description: A unit of work in the documentation cycle assigned to a person: provide entity financials, confirm transactions, review draft Local File, arrange certified translation, file with the tax authority, submit CbCR notification, resolve a validation finding; with the entity, country, fiscal year and document it concerns, assignee and requester, due date linked to the filing deadline, checklist, comments and attachments exchanged between group tax, local contacts, advisers and Reptune specialists, e-mail reminder schedule and delivery log, escalation and completion state. Created and tracked in Task Assignment, Collaboration and Reminders (task) from the Documentation Scope.
assets.businessMeaning: How a coordinator gets 50 entities in 30 countries to deliver on time without e-mail chaos: tasks with reminders are the operational heartbeat of the platform.
assets.accessScope: assignee, requester and coordinators of the owning client organisation; advisers and Reptune specialists for tasks assigned to them; task comments visible to task participants only

interfaces.name: workflow-task api
interfaces.description: Task creation from scope and findings, assignment, comment, attachment, reminder schedule, completion and escalation API used by the workflow module, the dashboard, the full-service workspace, e-mail reminders and calendar exports.

interfaces.name: task events
interfaces.description: Task created, assigned, commented, due-soon, overdue, completed and escalated events consumed by e-mail reminders, the compliance dashboard, service engagement tracking and the audit trail.

governance.retention: tasks kept 3 years after completion for cycle analytics, then reduced to completion facts kept with the fiscal year; comments and attachments deleted with the task unless attached to a document
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation and the advisers and Reptune specialists assigned to its tasks; reminder e-mails sent through Reptune's mail provider under a processor agreement; never shared between client organisations

subGroups.name: Insight and Risk
subGroups.description: The compliance status per country shown on the dashboard and worldmap, and the risk assessments and value chain analyses behind audit readiness.

assets.name: Compliance Status Snapshot
assets.description: The point-in-time compliance and performance picture of a client organisation that the dashboard widgets, graphs and worldmap render: per entity, country and fiscal year the scope decision, document status (not started, data collection, draft, review, final, filed), open actions required, upcoming and missed deadlines, CbCR and notification status, segmented result versus benchmark range indicators, and roll-ups per region, division and group; refreshed on every relevant event and snapshotted per fiscal-year milestone so that trends can be shown. Built by the Compliance Dashboard and Worldmap (dash) from scope, deadlines, documents, findings and financials.
assets.businessMeaning: The Head of Tax's answer to the audit committee in one screen: coverage, on-time status and risk per country at a glance, and the basis for the audit-ready documentation coverage north star.
assets.accessScope: group tax staff and management of the owning client organisation; local contacts see their own countries; advisers per organisation link; Reptune specialists per engagement; financial widgets only for users with financial-data rights

interfaces.name: compliance-status api
interfaces.description: Per-entity, per-country and roll-up status queries, worldmap feed, widget datasets, trend snapshots and export API used by the dashboard, the full-service workspace, management reporting and the open reporting export.

interfaces.name: status refresh events
interfaces.description: Status recomputed and snapshot taken events consumed by the dashboard cache, reminders and executive digests.

governance.retention: live status recomputed continuously; fiscal-year snapshots kept 10 years for trend reporting and audit-readiness evidence
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation, its advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; anonymised, aggregated compliance statistics across clients may be used by Reptune for product insight; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Risk Assessment
assets.description: A structured transfer pricing risk evaluation of a client organisation: value chain analysis mapping functions, assets, risks and profit allocation across entities and countries, risk indicators per transaction and entity (loss-making entities, results outside range, missing agreements or benchmarks, restructurings, high-risk jurisdictions, CbCR ratios such as profit per employee), audit history and open controversies, APA and MAP positions, mitigation actions and owners, and the resulting risk rating with review date; supported by Reptune's consultation services (value chain analysis, CbCR analysis, model review, controversy support). Maintained in Risk Management and Value Chain Analysis (rskm) against the Intercompany Transaction register.
assets.businessMeaning: Where documentation turns into defence: knowing which entities and transactions an auditor will pick, and having the evidence ready, is what 'saved the day in various tax audits' means in practice.
assets.accessScope: Head of Tax and group transfer pricing staff of the owning client organisation; Reptune advisory specialists per consultation engagement; advisers per organisation link; never visible to local contacts unless granted

interfaces.name: risk-assessment api
interfaces.description: Value chain model, risk indicator computation, rating, mitigation action and audit-history API used by the risk module, the dashboard, the Master File's value chain section and advisory engagements.

interfaces.name: risk events
interfaces.description: Indicator triggered, rating changed, mitigation assigned and audit opened or closed events consumed by workflow tasks, the dashboard and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept 10 years because controversies, APAs and MAPs span many fiscal years; superseded assessments versioned
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the Head of Tax and group transfer pricing staff; shared with Reptune advisory specialists under consultation engagements and with external counsel in controversies; legally privileged material flagged and excluded from exports; never shared between client organisations

rootGroups.name: Legal Entity and Agreement Data
rootGroups.description: The Legal Module's single source of truth across jurisdictions: time-stamped legal entities with shareholders, directors and authorised signatories, the intercompany agreements that back every controlled transaction, corporate documents, current and historical legal structure charts, and the DocuSign envelopes that get agreements signed. Directors' and signatories' personal data begins here.

subGroups.name: Entities and Structure
subGroups.description: Legal entities with bitemporal history, their corporate documents and the structure charts derived from ownership.

assets.name: Legal Entity
assets.description: A group company or branch administered in the Legal Module with full time-stamped history: legal name and former names, legal form, country of incorporation and tax residence, registration and tax identification numbers, registered address, fiscal-year end, functional currency, shareholders with ownership percentages and share classes, directors and officers with appointment and resignation dates, authorised signatories and signing rules, division membership, company type assignment for transfer pricing, CbCR constituent-entity role, status (active, dormant, in liquidation, merged) and every attribute versioned with valid-from and valid-to dates so that the structure on any past date can be reconstructed. Maintained in Legal Entity Management (lent), referenced by the transfer pricing model (tpmd), the transactions register (ictx), CbCR (cbcr), scoping (scop), corporate documents (cdoc), structure charts (lsch) and divisions (divs).
assets.businessMeaning: The spine of the whole domain: every transaction has two entities, every Local File belongs to one, every CbCR row lists them, and the legal counsel's accuracy of this record is what tax builds on.
assets.accessScope: legal counsel and company secretaries of the owning client organisation edit; group tax reads all entities; local contacts see their own entities; advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; directors' and signatories' personal data limited to legal and tax roles

interfaces.name: legal-entity api
interfaces.description: Entity, ownership, director, signatory and as-of-date query API with bitemporal history, used by the legal module, the transfer pricing model, transactions, CbCR, scoping, structure charts, divisions, the generator's entity descriptions and ERP integrations.

interfaces.name: entity bulk exchange
interfaces.description: Excel bulk entry and export of entities, shareholders and officers, and imports from corporate registers or the group's entity management system.

interfaces.name: entity lifecycle events
interfaces.description: Entity created, ownership changed, director or signatory appointed or resigned, tax residence changed, entity merged or liquidated events consumed by the transfer pricing model, structure charts, CbCR, scoping, agreements and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept for the life of the entity plus 10 years because corporate history must be reconstructable for tax audits and statute-of-limitations periods; personal data of former directors and signatories retained within the history record and minimised in exports
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation; entity facts disclosed to tax authorities through Local Files, the Master File and CbCR the client files; shared with advisers, notaries, auditors and Reptune specialists per engagement; personal data of directors and signatories never shared beyond legal and tax purposes; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Corporate Document
assets.description: A corporate record stored in the Legal Module against one or more entities: articles of association and amendments, incorporation deeds, registration extracts, board and shareholder resolutions, powers of attorney, director appointment and resignation letters, share transfer documents, tax residence certificates, rulings and APAs, and other documents legal counsel needs current across jurisdictions: document type, entities and persons concerned, effective and expiry dates, language, version, source and uploader, and retention class. Managed in the Corporate Document Repository (cdoc) and linked from Legal Entity Management (lent).
assets.businessMeaning: The evidence behind the entity record: when an auditor or a bank asks who could sign for a subsidiary on a given date, the answer is a document, not a spreadsheet.
assets.accessScope: legal counsel and company secretaries of the owning client organisation; group tax read access per document class; advisers and notaries for documents shared with them; uploads and downloads logged

interfaces.name: corporate-document api
interfaces.description: Upload, classify, version, link-to-entity, expiry tracking and secure-download API used by the corporate document repository, legal entity management, the generator's annexes and the archive.

interfaces.name: corporate document events
interfaces.description: Document uploaded, linked, expiring, superseded and downloaded events consumed by workflow tasks, entity change validation and the audit trail.

governance.retention: per retention class: constitutional documents for the life of the entity plus 10 years; resolutions and powers of attorney 10 years after expiry; rulings and APAs for their validity plus 10 years
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation; shared with its advisers, notaries, auditors, banks and authorities on request per document; visible to Reptune specialists only when linked to a documentation engagement; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Legal Structure Chart
assets.description: A rendered organisational chart of the group's legal ownership structure as of a chosen date: entities as nodes with country, legal form and status, ownership edges with percentages, division and sub-group groupings, optional overlays such as company type, CbCR jurisdiction or transfer pricing flows, layout and styling, the as-of date and generation timestamp, and exports in PDF, PowerPoint and image form for the Master File, board packs and bank or authority requests; regenerated on demand from the time-stamped entity data so that current and historical charts are always consistent with the register. Generated by Legal Structure Charts (lsch) from Legal Entity Management data.
assets.businessMeaning: The picture the Master File, the auditor and the board all ask for, produced in seconds for any date instead of redrawn by hand each year.
assets.accessScope: legal counsel and group tax staff of the owning client organisation; advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; exports logged

interfaces.name: structure-chart api
interfaces.description: As-of-date chart generation, overlay selection, layout, comparison between two dates and export API used by the legal module, the Master File generator and document rendering.

interfaces.name: structure chart exports
interfaces.description: PDF, PowerPoint and SVG or PNG exports inserted into the Master File and Local Files or delivered to boards, banks and authorities.

interfaces.name: chart events
interfaces.description: Chart generated and exported events consumed by the audit trail and the Master File's regeneration hints when the structure changes.

governance.retention: chart definitions regenerable from entity history; exported charts inserted into documentation follow the 7 to 10 year documentation retention
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation; disclosed through the Master File and on request to authorities, banks and auditors; never shared between client organisations

subGroups.name: Agreements and Signatures
subGroups.description: Intercompany agreements that cover controlled transactions and the DocuSign envelopes through which they are signed.

assets.name: Intercompany Agreement
assets.description: A contract between group entities that legally backs one or more controlled transactions: agreement type (distribution, services, licence, loan, cost contribution, cash pool, guarantee), parties and their authorised signatories, effective and termination dates, pricing clause and its link to the transfer pricing policy, governing law, amendments and renewals, template used and drafting notes, signature status and the signed document with e-signature evidence, coverage of transactions in the register and gaps flagged where a transaction has no agreement. Maintained in the Intercompany Agreement Repository (icag), signed through E-Signature Integration (esig) and inserted automatically into Local Files by the generator.
assets.businessMeaning: Contemporaneous agreements are the first request in almost every transfer pricing audit; agreement coverage of transactions is the legal counsel's north star and a direct input to audit readiness.
assets.accessScope: legal counsel and group tax staff of the owning client organisation; local contacts see agreements of their own entities; advisers and Reptune specialists per engagement; signatories receive their envelopes only

interfaces.name: intercompany-agreement api
interfaces.description: Agreement drafting from templates, party and signatory selection, transaction coverage, amendment, signature initiation and secure-download API used by the agreement repository, the transactions register, e-signature, the generator and validation.

interfaces.name: agreement events
interfaces.description: Agreement drafted, sent for signature, signed, amended, expiring, terminated and coverage-gap events consumed by validation, actions required, reminders, the generator's annexes and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept for the term of the agreement plus 10 years because agreements are examined for every fiscal year they governed; signed versions and their signature evidence immutable
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation; provided to tax authorities as annexes to Local Files or on request; shared with advisers, auditors and counsel per engagement; sent to DocuSign for signing under a processor agreement; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: E-Signature Envelope
assets.description: The signing transaction for an agreement or corporate document through DocuSign: envelope id, documents included, recipients with role, routing order, authentication method and e-mail, signing events with timestamps and IP-derived location, reminders and expiry, completion certificate and audit trail from the provider, resulting signed PDF stored against the agreement, and status (created, sent, delivered, signed, declined, voided, expired). Generated, sent, stored and tracked by E-Signature Integration (esig) for agreements in the Intercompany Agreement Repository.
assets.businessMeaning: The proof that the right people signed the right version on a given date: signature evidence is what makes an intercompany agreement enforceable and credible to an auditor.
assets.accessScope: legal counsel of the owning client organisation who initiate envelopes; signatories through DocuSign only; group tax sees signature status; Reptune integration operators for troubleshooting under support access

interfaces.name: e-signature api
interfaces.description: Envelope creation from an agreement, recipient routing, send, remind, void, status polling and evidence retrieval API used by the agreement repository, workflow tasks and the archive.

interfaces.name: envelope webhooks
interfaces.description: DocuSign Connect webhooks for sent, delivered, signed, declined, voided and completed events consumed by agreement status, reminders, the document store and the audit trail.

governance.retention: envelope metadata and completion certificates kept with the signed agreement for its term plus 10 years; the DocuSign-side copy retained per the provider agreement and purged after evidence retrieval
governance.sharingPolicy: exchanged with DocuSign as processor under contract; signatories' personal data limited to name, e-mail, timestamps and authentication evidence; internal to the client organisation and its counsel; never shared between client organisations

rootGroups.name: Platform, AI and Service Data
rootGroups.description: The data that keeps the platform secure, multi-tenant and operable and that runs Reptune's own use of it: users, SSO and access rights, client organisations and divisions, the ISO 27001 audit trail, ERP and identity integration connections, R-AI and AI-writing interaction logs, and the service engagements under which Reptune specialists prepare documentation at fixed rates per Local File.

subGroups.name: Identity, Organisations and Audit
subGroups.description: Who may do what in which organisation, and the tamper-evident trail of what was done.

assets.name: User Account
assets.description: A person's account on Reptune.net: name, business e-mail, employer (client organisation, advisory firm or Reptune), authentication method (password with MFA, SSO through the client's identity provider for Advanced and Enterprise plans), user profile and custom access rights (administrator, editor, read-only, location-restricted to countries or entities, financial-data access), organisation and division memberships including adviser links to several client organisations, notification and language preferences, invitation and status (invited, active, suspended, deactivated), last sign-in and session data. Managed in Identity, SSO, User Profiles and Access Control (iden) and protected by Security and ISO 27001 Controls (secp); plans include unlimited users.
assets.businessMeaning: The gate to commercially sensitive tax data: correct roles and location restrictions are what let a group open the platform to hundreds of local contacts and advisers without exposing the whole group.
assets.accessScope: the user for own profile; organisation administrators of the owning client organisation for their users; Reptune support with logged, ticket-bound access; credentials never readable

interfaces.name: identity api
interfaces.description: Authentication, SSO federation (SAML and OpenID Connect), invitation, profile, role and access-rights, session and deactivation API used by every module's authorisation checks, organisation administration, the full-service workspace and support tooling.

interfaces.name: account events
interfaces.description: User invited, activated, role changed, SSO linked, suspended, deactivated and suspicious sign-in events consumed by the audit trail, security monitoring, notifications and organisation administration.

governance.retention: kept while the account is active and 2 years after deactivation for access reconstruction, then pseudonymised in the audit trail; sign-in and session logs 12 months
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation and Reptune; identity attributes exchanged with the client's identity provider for SSO; never shared with other client organisations; adviser accounts see only organisations that granted them access

assets.name: Client Organisation
assets.description: A tenant of the platform and its commercial and structural settings: the multinational group or advisory firm, contract and plan (Core, Advanced, Enterprise), Local File allowance and add-ons (machine translation, CbCR and EU Public CbCR, SSO, R-AI Country Expert, custom templates, custom transactional data model, custom development), included expert hours, service level, divisions for multi-group structures with their own entity sets and user scopes, corporate identity settings, adviser organisations linked to the client, data residency and retention preferences, trial and contract dates, account manager and status. Managed in Identity, SSO, User Profiles and Access Control (iden) and Divisions and Client Organisations (divs); the root of tenant isolation for every other asset.
assets.businessMeaning: The tenant boundary and the commercial record in one: everything a client sees is scoped by it, and plan, allowance and add-ons determine what the platform does for them.
assets.accessScope: organisation administrators of the client for settings and divisions; Reptune account management and support for plan and contract attributes; every module reads tenant scope; never visible to other organisations

interfaces.name: client-organisation api
interfaces.description: Tenant, plan, add-on, allowance, division, adviser-link, branding and residency setting API used by authorisation, scoping allowance checks, feature gating, the full-service workspace, billing exports and support tooling.

interfaces.name: organisation events
interfaces.description: Organisation created, trial started, plan or add-on changed, division added, adviser linked or unlinked and contract ended events consumed by feature gating, allowance checks, service engagements, offboarding exports and the audit trail.

governance.retention: kept for the life of the contract plus 7 years for commercial and fiscal records; on contract end the client's data is exported to the client and deleted after the agreed export period except what Reptune must retain for its own fiscal obligations
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to Reptune and the client's administrators; plan and usage facts shared with Reptune's billing system; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Audit Trail Entry
assets.description: An immutable record of an action on the platform: actor (user, adviser, Reptune specialist, integration or system job), organisation and division, timestamp, action type (sign-in, data change with before and after values, document generated, version created, file downloaded or exported, translation requested, AI suggestion accepted, access right granted, integration run, support access opened), the object concerned, origin (web, API, integration, AI service), request and session ids and result. Written by Audit Trail, Versioning and Archive (audt) for every module and reviewed under Security and ISO 27001 Controls (secp); the basis for document version history and for answering 'who changed this Local File and when' in an audit.
assets.businessMeaning: The evidence of control the ISO 27001 certification and the client's auditors rely on, and the version history that makes every documentation change explainable years later.
assets.accessScope: security officers and organisation administrators of the owning client organisation for their own organisation's trail; Reptune security and compliance staff for platform-wide review; append-only, no edit or delete rights for anyone

interfaces.name: audit-trail api
interfaces.description: Append, query by organisation, object, actor and period, version diff and export API used by every module's change logging, document version history, security monitoring, ISO 27001 evidence collection and client audit requests.

interfaces.name: audit events
interfaces.description: Audit entry appended and anomaly detected events consumed by security monitoring, alerting and periodic access reviews.

governance.retention: entries concerning documentation and data changes kept 10 years to match the longest documentation retention; sign-in and access logs kept 12 months under the ISO 27001 logging control; personal identifiers pseudonymised after account deactivation
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to Reptune security and the client's own administrators; extracts provided to the client's auditors and to certification auditors under confidentiality; never shared between client organisations

subGroups.name: Integrations, AI and Services
subGroups.description: External system connections, AI interaction records and the service engagements through which Reptune delivers documentation.

assets.name: Integration Connection
assets.description: The configuration and health of a link between a client organisation and an external system: direct ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics and others) for entity financials and transactional data, operational transfer pricing solutions pushing segmented results, SFTP and API-based Excel data exchange, SSO identity providers, DocuSign, calendar and e-mail connectors, and Enterprise custom developments: connection type and endpoint, credentials referenced by vault id, entity and field mappings, schedule, scope and filters, last run and error log, data owner and technical contact, and status. Managed in ERP and Operational Transfer Pricing Integrations (erpi) and the source of every Data Upload Batch that arrives automatically.
assets.businessMeaning: The Year-3 strategy in data: direct ERP and operational transfer pricing integrations as standard are what turn annual data collection into continuous flow.
assets.accessScope: integration administrators of the owning client organisation; Reptune integration operators; credentials never readable after creation; run logs visible to both

interfaces.name: integration-connection api
interfaces.description: Connection registration, credential vaulting, mapping, schedule, test-run, health and error-log API used by the integrations module, bulk upload, SSO configuration, e-signature and support tooling.

interfaces.name: integration health events
interfaces.description: Connection created, run started, run succeeded, run failed, credential expiring and connection disabled events consumed by data upload batches, workflow tasks, alerting and the audit trail.

governance.retention: configuration kept for the life of the connection plus 2 years; run and error logs 3 years; secrets destroyed on connection deletion
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the client organisation and Reptune integration operators; credentials shared with no one; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: AI Interaction Log
assets.description: The record of one interaction with the platform's AI capabilities: an R-AI conversation (onboarding assistant or country-expert question in any language) with the retrieved sources and the answer, an AI-assisted writing or editing suggestion in a text field with the original and accepted text, or a machine translation job with glossary hits and reviewer corrections; with user, organisation, model and prompt version, context objects (entity, section, country), confidence, latency, human acceptance or rejection, feedback rating and flags for review. Written by the R-AI Assistant (rai) and AI-assisted Writing and Editing (aiwr) and reviewed by Expert Support and Advisory Hours (supp) when users escalate AI answers to a specialist.
assets.businessMeaning: How Reptune keeps AI under specialist supervision: acceptance rates, corrections and escalations tell the content team where R-AI's answers and the writing assistant need better knowledge.
assets.accessScope: the user for own interactions; AI product and content specialists of Reptune for quality review under pseudonymisation; organisation administrators see usage statistics; never visible to other organisations

interfaces.name: ai-interaction api
interfaces.description: Conversation, suggestion and translation job logging, feedback, escalation-to-specialist and usage statistics API used by R-AI, AI-assisted writing, machine translation, support and the content team's quality review.

interfaces.name: ai interaction events
interfaces.description: Answer given, suggestion accepted or rejected, low-confidence answer flagged and escalated-to-expert events consumed by support tickets, knowledge-base maintenance and usage dashboards.

governance.retention: interaction content kept 12 months for quality review and then reduced to pseudonymised statistics; interactions that changed documentation text are referenced from the audit trail and follow its retention
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the user's organisation and Reptune's AI and content team; prompts sent to the model provider under a processor agreement with no training on client data; never shared between client organisations

assets.name: Service Engagement
assets.description: A contracted service delivered by Reptune's transfer pricing specialists to a client organisation on the platform: Full Service or Collaborative documentation for a fiscal year with the agreed entities and countries at fixed rates per Local File, included expert hours per plan (2, 4 or 8) and their consumption, on-demand consultation cases (value chain analysis, CbCR analysis, functional analysis, model review, policy write-up, controversy, restructuring, APA or MAP support), assigned specialists, delivery milestones and lead times, client review rounds and rework, service-level switches (On Demand, Collaborative, Full Service), deliverables and hours to invoice. Managed in the Full Service Delivery Workspace (fsvc) and Expert Support and Advisory Hours (supp) against the client's Documentation Scope.
assets.businessMeaning: Where software and services meet: engagements carry the fixed-fee margin, the specialist productivity of 25 percent of traditional adviser time and the client's ability to switch service level without rework.
assets.accessScope: Reptune service delivery, advisory and account management staff; client contacts see their own engagement status, hours and deliverables; advisers only for engagements they participate in

interfaces.name: service-engagement api
interfaces.description: Engagement setup from scope and plan, specialist assignment, hours tracking, milestone, review-round, service-level switch and invoicing export API used by the full-service workspace, support, the dashboard and Reptune's billing system.

interfaces.name: engagement events
interfaces.description: Engagement started, milestone reached, hours threshold reached, review round opened, service level switched and engagement closed events consumed by workflow tasks, client notifications, billing and delivery analytics.

governance.retention: kept for the life of the client relationship plus 7 years for Reptune's own fiscal and professional-liability records; advisory case notes concerning controversies kept 10 years
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to Reptune and the client's engagement contacts; hours and deliverable facts shared with Reptune's billing system; never shared between client organisations; advisory notes may be legally privileged and are excluded from bulk exports

stores.name: Transfer Pricing Model DB
stores.description: Multi-tenant relational schema (PostgreSQL-style, row-level client-organisation keys) for the transfer pricing model: company types, functional analyses, methods, intercompany transaction registers, segmented financials, benchmark references, scoping decisions and the custom transactional data model of Enterprise clients; the intelligent data model Reptune has developed since 2015.

stores.name: Documentation Output Store
stores.description: Encrypted object storage for generated Master Files and Local Files in Word and PDF, draft and final versions, translated versions, localised templates, custom text blocks, styling assets (logos, fonts, corporate identity) and the archive of prior-year documentation; versioned, immutable once marked final.

stores.name: Documentation and Model Search Index
