stores.description: Full-text and faceted search index over entities, transactions, agreements, documents, templates, custom text and country regulation content used by the web application's global search and by R-AI retrieval.

stores.name: Data Exchange Staging Zone
stores.description: Secure, access-logged landing zone for Excel bulk-upload templates, ERP extracts and operational transfer pricing pushes per client organisation, with checksum, duplicate detection and validation results held until the batch is accepted into the model or rejected; purged on a short schedule.

stores.name: Country Regulations Content DB
stores.description: Relational content store maintained by Reptune's regulations specialists for 170+ countries: documentation thresholds, content and format requirements, filing and language rules, local forms, deadline rules per fiscal-year pattern, effective-dated versions and change notes; the knowledge base behind localisation, deadline calculation and R-AI's country-expert answers.

stores.name: Translation Memory and Glossary Store
stores.description: Store for transfer pricing glossaries per language pair, client-specific terminology, translation memory segments and human-certified translation corrections that steer the machine translation engine across 28 languages.

stores.name: R-AI Knowledge Vector Store
stores.description: Embedding index over Reptune product documentation, onboarding guides, OECD-aligned template structure and country regulation content that R-AI retrieves from when answering onboarding and country-expert questions; contains no client documentation unless a client enables private retrieval within its own organisation scope.

stores.name: AI Interaction Store
stores.description: Document store for R-AI conversations, AI-assisted writing prompts and suggestions, machine translation jobs and their acceptance or correction, with model version, retrieval sources, confidence and human review outcome; scoped per client organisation and purged on schedule.

stores.name: CbCR Reporting DB
stores.description: Relational store for Country-by-Country Reporting datasets per reporting fiscal year (Table 1 aggregates, Table 2 constituent entities and activities, Table 3 additional information), validation status, generated OECD XML and Excel outputs, EU Public CbCR XHTML with inline XBRL, notification records and filing acknowledgements.

stores.name: Benchmark Library Store
stores.description: Object storage for benchmark study reports, comparable sets, search strategies and arm's-length range tables archived per transaction type and validity period, with metadata projected into the transfer pricing model DB for automatic insertion into Local Files.

stores.name: Workflow and Compliance DB
stores.description: Relational store for documentation scoping per fiscal year, calculated deadline instances per entity and country, workflow tasks, assignments, comments, e-mail reminder logs, compliance status snapshots feeding the dashboard and worldmap, and risk assessments and value chain analysis records.

stores.name: Legal Module DB
stores.description: Bitemporal relational store for legal entities, shareholders and ownership percentages, directors, authorised signatories, registration numbers and tax identifiers, intercompany agreement metadata and structure chart definitions; every change time-stamped with valid-from and valid-to dates so current and historical views can be reconstructed.

stores.name: Corporate Document Store
stores.description: Encrypted object storage for intercompany agreements and amendments, articles of association, registration extracts, board resolutions, powers of attorney, signed agreements with e-signature evidence, and exported structure charts; versioned and retention-classed per document.

stores.name: DocuSign Envelope Mirror
stores.description: Synchronised copy of DocuSign envelopes, recipients, signing events, timestamps, certificates of completion and audit trails exchanged with the e-signature provider, keyed by envelope id.

stores.name: Platform Identity and Organisation DB
stores.description: Store for client organisations, plans and add-ons, divisions, users, custom user profiles and access rights (read-only, location-restricted), SSO federation settings, MFA enrolment, sessions, invitations and adviser-to-client organisation links backing platform-wide authentication and authorisation.

stores.name: Audit Log Store
stores.description: Append-only, tamper-evident store for user actions, data changes, document versions, generation runs, downloads, exports, access grants and administrative events across the platform, retained to satisfy ISO 27001 logging controls and client audit requests.

stores.name: Integration Configuration DB
stores.description: Relational store for ERP and operational transfer pricing integration connections, SSO identity provider registrations, field and entity mappings, schedules, webhook subscriptions, health status and error logs; secrets referenced by vault id only.

stores.name: Integration Secrets Vault
stores.description: Hardware-backed secrets store for ERP API credentials, SFTP keys, SSO certificates, DocuSign and translation-engine API keys; write-only after creation, rotated and access-audited under the ISO 27001 control set.

stores.name: Service Delivery DB
stores.description: Relational store for full-service and collaborative engagements: contracted local files at fixed rates, included expert hours and their consumption, specialist assignments, delivery milestones, client review rounds and advisory case notes.

stores.name: Compliance Analytics Warehouse
stores.description: Per-client analytical warehouse behind dashboard widgets, graphs and the worldmap, holding governed copies of entities, scopes, deadlines, tasks, document status, segmented results versus benchmark ranges and CbCR aggregates with fiscal-year snapshots; pseudonymised where source assets carry personal data.

stores.name: Domain Event Bus
stores.description: Platform-wide, client-organisation-scoped event bus carrying model, upload, validation, generation, deadline, task, CbCR, entity, agreement, signature, account and audit events to workflow, dashboards, reminders, the warehouse, the search index and integration webhooks.
